profile.name: Rafael Campo
profile.title: Software Architect — Backend & Cloud Systems
profile.text: Experienced Scala Engineer and Backend Architect specializing in high-performance, scalable distributed systems and AI agent platforms. Proficient in reviewing AI-generated Scala code, system designs, and technical explanations, with a focus on assessing correctness, clarity, performance, and identifying errors in concurrency, JVM performance, and functional correctness. Adept at developing AI training content, optimizing AI performance, and ensuring model integrity.

jobs.title: Solution Architect Cloud & Backend Systems
achievements: Architected and deployed 10+ high-throughput microservices on AWS (ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda) supporting 10K+ active users, reducing AWS infrastructure costs from $30K to $10K monthly (67% savings) while maintaining sub-100ms latency across distributed systems.

Led architectural migration from monolithic to high-availability distributed microservices, reducing deployment time by 60% and enabling independent teams to deploy in parallel, increasing deployment frequency from 1 per week to on-demand (3+ weekly), enhancing scalability and system resilience.

Engineered production authentication layer in Clojure using JWT tokens, securing high-throughput systems handling 10K+ concurrent users with semantic search and payment processing capabilities, ensuring zero-downtime deployments and functional correctness through REPL-driven development.

Architected reliable, debuggable infrastructure leveraging Clojure's functional programming paradigm and interactive REPL environment, enabling rapid iteration and deep system introspection while maintaining 99.99% uptime for payment and loyalty-critical services.

Engineered robust Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) workflows covering 50+ AWS resources across multiple environments, reducing infrastructure setup time by 80% and accelerating onboarding for 12+ engineers on distributed system initiatives.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
achievements: Engineered latency-sensitive backend services in Clojure, optimizing JVM performance for sub-50ms response times within high-throughput distributed systems handling 5K+ requests per second.

Contributed to architectural design of microservices leveraging Clojure's immutability and functional correctness principles, enhancing system reliability and enabling efficient parallel processing for complex data transformations.

jobs.title: Implementation Analyst
achievements: Developed scalable, custom data integration solutions (Python-based), delivering tailored enterprise workflows and production-ready backend solutions, emphasizing functional correctness and performance for complex client requirements.
Contributed to database design and optimization strategies to support complex data processing needs, ensuring system scalability and consistency.

Key Tech: AWS (RDS, EKS, Lambda, S3, Bedrock, DynamoDB, ECR, CloudWatch)
